judgments.normative_policy: Only explicit registered subject/category selection is a hard taxonomy predicate. Ordinary descriptive/topical wording is semantic discovery; advisory wording is advisory. C4 rollback inference may remain unchanged, while the V11 candidate must honor this explicit policy.

examples.expected: Semantic topic fiction writing; no mandatory Fiction subject invented.
Semantic Physics discovery unless the interaction explicitly selects a registered Physics category. Do not require hard subject merely because Physics exists in taxonomy.
Hard canonical subjects=[Fiction], all-membership semantics, exact authorized taxonomy match or reviewed source-backed alias.
Hard exclude_subjects=[Fiction]; do not substitute broad searchable-text exclusion.
Advisory semantic preference; no enforced subject chip.
INCOMPLETE if the taxonomy operator is supported; retain source-owned missing operand.
UNSUPPORTED or targeted category-selection clarification under a frozen typed policy; never silently broaden to topic or invent a taxonomy row.

mask_migration.old_mask_conflict: Historical masks sometimes demand subjects/include_terms for bare descriptive subject wording. V11 user policy explicitly distinguishes topical discovery from selected category membership.
replacement_masks: For ordinary topics assert absence of invented mandatory subject fields and preservation of semantic subject meaning.
For explicit category selection assert canonical value, include/exclude polarity, source span and actual returned membership constraints.
Preserve original historical labels and raw comparison scores; apply a separately versioned source-reviewed semantic mask, not expected values chosen from candidate output.
mask_migration.do_not_claim: Semantic word retention alone does not prove retrieval relevance.

judgments.normative_policy: ONLINE only means online=True and physical=False; PHYSICAL only means physical=True and online=False. BOTH means both True. A present-format requirement alone permits both. Explicit exclusions require established negative capability, not unknown absence.
native_facts: QueryPlan declares exclusive_formats and excluded_formats. Baseline matches checks formats and excluded_formats but never reads exclusive_formats.
Therefore a proven ONLY operation may require deriving the opposite excluded_formats predicate; an empty legacy expected excluded_formats list is not by itself an enforcement oracle.
Baseline matches rejects an excluded flag only when it is exactly True; missing/None/unknown is accepted, which cannot prove known absence.

Institutional canonical format pipeline computes has_physical/has_online from scoped holdings and authorized READY assets. Global canonical has_physical=False by scope and has_online from current actor-readable borrowed entitlement.
judgments.unknown_flag_policy: Missing/unknown required format data is nonmatching or fails safely with a clear provider/capability error. A negative-only condition must not accept a row solely because its requested flag was not hydrated. Do not widen native C4 semantics globally merely to test preview behavior.

global_defect.baseline: GlobalQuerySearch.search constructs online only if plan.formats or plan.availability, omitting excluded_formats. The constrained-provider boolean also omits excluded_formats.
global_defect.required_fix: The disabled candidate must derive trusted entitlements for positive, ONLY and negative format demands; enforce canonical predicates before pagination and after hydration/serialization. Retrieval prefilters for negatives must implement complement correctly rather than using the positive entitlement $in universe.
global_defect.global_scope: Global PHYSICAL/BOTH positive requests remain unsupported. Excluding PHYSICAL is a known scope tautology only if it means native global physical capability, never proof of external print-edition absence. Global ONLINE is actor entitlement, not complete catalog ebook availability.

mask_migration.replacement: Score source modality/operand and semantic native acceptance over a known/unknown flag truth table. Permit a documented derived opposite exclusion for ONLY; do not count it as invented user hard meaning. Preserve bitwise raw old scores separately.
mask_migration.precondition: Actual execution/canonical-flag tests, including missing flags, multi-format rows, and negative-only global entitlement derivation. Matching lists of parsed fields are insufficient.

judgments.normative_policy: A recognized mandatory operation on a known unsupported domain returns UNSUPPORTED even if its operand is missing. Preserve the missing operand state and source in QueryIntent; do not offer a numeric completion as if it could enable the operation. This rule addresses unsupported-versus-INCOMPLETE priority; all other simultaneous blocker priority must be explicitly frozen as well.
judgments.reason: No QueryPlan field or native matches predicate can enforce page count for any completion. Clarifying the number cannot repair the capability deficit. Native source establishes unsupportedness, while typed priority is an explicit V11 normative choice, not a fact discovered from DTO presence.

historical_expectations.original: scratch/search_arch9_regression/test_search_v2c_c4_reviewed_legacy.py::test_curated_candidate_plan[gold-088] expects INCOMPLETE for books under pages. V10 kept this expectation as an operand-first repair.
historical_expectations.review: V10 source-only review already recommended capability-first UNSUPPORTED, while acknowledging that INCOMPLETE could be execution-safe if capability limits were explicit. V11 resolves that discretionary contradiction by choosing capability-first.

replacement_assertions: books under pages is UNSUPPORTED with page-count capability reason.
IR retains mandatory page_count operator/source and omitted/missing operand state.
Supplying a numeric page count stays UNSUPPORTED and cannot create rating/year/text substitute filters.
Missing supported author/rating operands remain INCOMPLETE and receive targeted completion.
A topical request about page layout or an advisory concise preference does not become a page-count filter.
Retain every other applicable original field assertion unchanged; only documented decision precedence changes.

judgments.normative_policy: Preview requires server-enabled configuration AND backend-authorized actor selection. Client query flags, URL state or frontend environment flags alone cannot enable the candidate, choose a tenant, obtain staff access, or activate advanced semantics. Disabled default must dispatch through the unchanged C4/EXACT default behavior.
required_guards: Server setting defaults false; allowlisted/current actor authorization controls preview selection. Treat malformed/unknown server configuration conservatively.
Derive scope and role only through existing current-identity/current-membership guards; authenticate before facets, state lookup, provider/index access or hydration.
Keep EXACT on existing native semantics without experimental extraction; mode must be included in state ownership/version binding.

Bind accepted and pending state to owner, login sid, library, staff/patron workspace, mode, original/accepted source digests, IR digest, parser/candidate version, accepted plan version, expiry and one-use state.

Reject foreign, expired, stale, replayed or feature-version-mismatched state before applying server-issued source edits. Do not accept arbitrary client plans, source offsets or model-proposed fields as authority.
Partition and cancel frontend result/state requests by trusted library/workspace/mode/session/candidate context; no stale response may repaint a newly selected library.
Use no-store/private caching; do not reuse a query-only cache across tenants or actors.
Return applied-filter metadata only for actual enforced predicates; advisory source is visually distinct; guarded/unsupported response must not imply filters were searched.
Rollback is a server configuration change with no database migration. Preview state must not be consumed by the C4 parser or vice versa.
native_integration_risks: Baseline HUMAN /search calls the global human_search handler and does not pass request.library_id. The candidate must dispatch institution scope explicitly after authorization rather than treating a client library_id as authority or silently searching GLOBAL.

Native collection()/session/offer calls create indexes and persist session/clarification records. Baseline catalogue.read_context can run canonical maintenance under library_mutation/access_locked. Calling these during a purported read-only probe can mutate data.
Native GlobalQuerySearch and tenant search bound candidate pools before final pagination. Returned-row safety is not complete recall, exhaustive totals or globally complete sort ordering.
Current 150-character ChoiceRequest and tenant search transport must be reconciled with 500-character accepted sources end to end; widening one DTO is not sufficient.

Native one-use reservation/CAS code provides an implementation basis, but no source review proves real Mongo durability, crash recovery or current JWT security. Mock contracts must be labeled as mock tests.

Tenant unlinked records do not need global metadata; linked hydrate still queries global metadata and may fail if that query is unavailable. No full private/global-outage independence claim follows from unlinked fixtures.

limitations: This is a source-only normative review over the preserved native baseline and V10 review artifacts. It does not inspect or approve candidate implementation.
No V11 predictions, newly authored acceptance population, sealed historical heldout, live application, database, JWT, model, provider or index was used.
No tests were run by this reviewer. Required replacement tests and integration guards must be implemented and verified by the main task.
Source proves available code paths and native semantics, not actual field data quality, relevance, durable consumption, service health or full catalog recall.
